If the ID differs, a new reviewed capsule baseline is required — update CAPSULE_V1_EXPECTED_IMAGE_ID in src/config/constants.ts, re-run the P0-E suite, and record a new proof entry in docs/BUILD_LOG.md and the Release Ledger.
